description: First assembly draft for a real business sample package. Fill the staging CSV files first, then complete the JSON payload files.
currentAssumptions: The first real sample should focus on one workshop or one production area.
The planning horizon should start with 2 to 7 days.
The current solver only supports independent tasks, candidate resources, downtimes, pinned resource, and pinned start constraints.

files.purpose: Final resource master JSON to be produced from 07_resource_staging.csv
Final task JSON to be produced from 08_task_staging.csv
Final downtime JSON to be produced from 09_downtime_staging.csv
Final request payload assembled from 01/02/03 and 06_request_context_mapping.csv
Package usage notes and completion criteria
Mapping table for scenario parameters and solver settings
Row-level staging table for real business resource data
Row-level staging table for real business task data
Row-level staging table for real business downtime data
Register of unresolved mapping issues and unsupported business constraints

completionChecklist: 06_request_context_mapping.csv has confirmed draft values and source fields.

08_task_staging.csv has enough rows to generate a non-empty 02_tasks.json.
